title: Boots, Beer and Bingo
shortDescription: Free country Music Bingo and prizes featuring Angels for the Underdogs at Charter 803, with an optional cash-only 50/50 raffle run by Angels.
description: Come out for Boots, Beer and Bingo, a Four Dogs Community Awareness Night featuring Angels for the Underdogs. Enjoy free-to-play country Music Bingo and prizes while meeting a Lexington nonprofit that advocates for vulnerable dogs. Representatives will share their mission and invite guests to support their work. An optional cash-only 50/50 raffle is handled entirely by Angels for the Underdogs; Four Dogs does not collect raffle money.
instructions: Free to play. Food and drinks are purchased separately. The optional cash-only 50/50 raffle is run directly by Angels for the Underdogs. Contact Charter 803 for seating details.
metaDescription: Boots, Beer and Bingo at Charter 803, Lexington, November 18 at 6:30 PM. Free Music Bingo, Angels for the Underdogs spotlight and optional cash-only raffle.
